property.name: InVerticalBlank
property.summary: Gets the status of the vertical blank period.

property.name: ScanLine
property.summary: Gets a value that roughly corresponds to the current scan line painted by the raster.
property.remarks: If InVerticalBlank is false , this property's value is an integer that roughly corresponds to the current scan line painted by the raster. Scan lines are numbered in the same way as Microsoft Direct3D surface coordinates: 0 is the top of the primary surface, extending to the value (height of the surface − 1) at the bottom of the display. If InVerticalBlank is true , this value is set to 0 and can be ignored.
